status.summary: dataR's construction-progress post 'Baufortschritt in Bildern', published on 1 September 2026, adds an 'August 2026' section of 16 aerial photographs of its Rellingen data-centre construction site, each dated 2026-08-27 in the operator's file name ('Baustelle von oben'). They show the building with its rooftop cooling plant and stacks installed while a tower crane, site cabins and site fencing remain on the plot, so the project was still under construction on 27 August 2026. The status keeps the existing scope (the dataR data-centre build in Rellingen); it does not assert completion, commissioning or the operator's planned opening for customers in the fourth quarter of 2026.

status_updates.identity_review: The post is on dataR GmbH's own website, which documents a single project: the dataR data centre in Rellingen that is the existing Atlas record curated:datar-rellingen-campus:current-build (status source https://www.datar.de/zwei-neue-kollegen-ein-gemeinsamer-start/, 17 July 2026). The post documents 'unseren Baufortschritt' (our construction progress) in monthly sections from January 2024 onwards, matching the record's construction history (construction start January 2024 per dataR's press page), and the August 2026 file names name the dataR construction site ('dataR_Baustelle'). The photographs show one building on one plot; nothing indicates a second phase or another site, so this refreshes the same project with the same scope and leaves the reviewed site locator unchanged. The 22 October thirty-fourth holds noted that dataR progress pages had no dated statement newer than the existing record; this action relies on the explicit 2026-08-27 photograph dates in the August 2026 section, bounded by the 1 September 2026 post date shown on the page, in the news index and in the RSS feed.
status_updates.successor_review: Strictly newer than the existing 17 July 2026 observation. Checked on 23 October 2026: dataR's news index and RSS feed list no item after 'Baufortschritt in Bildern' (1 September 2026); the post sitemap shows no later modification; and dataR's press page still states the forecast opening for customers in early Q4 2026 without reporting completion or opening. No completion, commissioning, opening, pause or cancellation was found, so under_construction as of 27 August 2026 is kept and no later stage is inferred.
